name: com.sgonzalezrozo.slot-list
description: Recycling (virtualized) scroll view for Unity uGUI: long lists and grids that reuse a few slots, with dynamic sizes, expandable slots, headers, pull to refresh and infinite scroll with pagination.

samples.description: Scripts for a simple list of 10,000 recycled items.
Grid, bento, sections, expandable rows, a looping carousel and paging. Each builds its UI in code: add it to an empty scene and press Play. No TextMeshPro needed.
A pull-to-refresh indicator and an empty-state panel. Uses TextMeshPro.
